press_references.value: SCZONE hosts Nanjing delegation to discuss new Chinese industrial investments

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) hosted an official delegation from Nanjing, China, to discuss expanding industrial investment cooperation across sectors such as renewable energy, automotive components, and medical industries within the zone.

press_references.value: SCZONE, China's Qianhai Shenzhen mull cooperation in logistics, digital infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Economic Zone and China's Qianhai Shenzhen Zone are exploring a partnership focused on logistics, digital infrastructure, and advanced technologies, with Qianhai expressing readiness to cooperate in modern logistics, IT, maritime tech and innovation-related services.

press_references.value: SCZone signs $525M agreement to establish phosphate fertilizer plant in Sokhna

partnership_announcements.description: SCZONE signed a $525 million agreement with Indorama Egypt Fertilizers to establish a new phosphate fertilizer plant in the Sokhna Industrial Zone as part of an integrated fertilizers and chemicals complex.

press_references.value: Egypt: SCZONE signs $34mln deal with China’s CNCEC for Sokhna soda ash project

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Economic Zone signed a contract with China National Chemical Engineering Company to develop $34 million production lines and facilities for a Soda Ash-related steel and pipe manufacturing project in Sokhna Industrial Zone, as the first of two integrated industrial projects.

press_references.value: Egypt: SCZONE, China Harbour Engineering explore port, infrastructure projects

partnership_announcements.description: SCZONE and China Harbour Engineering discussed new cooperation opportunities on developing port and infrastructure projects in Egypt, aiming to enhance port capacity and logistics integration.

press_references.value: PM witnesses signing of land development contract in Sokhna Industrial Zone

partnership_announcements.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) and TEDA Egypt signed a new land development contract for a 2.86-square-kilometer plot in the Sokhna Industrial Zone, expanding TEDA Egypt's development area and reinforcing their ongoing partnership to attract industrial investments.

press_references.value: Ain Sokhna Port welcomes AROYA cruise ship with over 2,300 tourists

partnership_announcements.description: SCZONE and AD Ports Group have formed an international partnership to manage and develop cruise terminals in Egypt, supporting the country's marine tourism strategy.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Economic Zone offers promising opportunities for investors: Egypt's PM

partnership_announcements.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone partnered with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and Agility to digitize investor services and enhance business performance.

press_references.value: Egypt Expands Textile Industry with $10M New Chinese Investment in SCZone

partnership_announcements.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) has partnered with Jiangsu Guotai to establish a garment factory in Qantara West, Egypt, as part of a $10 million investment.

press_references.value: SCZONE signs contracts for smart truck yard at West Port Said with EGP 250m investment

partnership_announcements.description: The partnership involves developing and operating a smart truck yard at West Port Said, featuring automated gates, RFID-based tracking, and a command center.

press_references.value: Egypt’s SCZone launches digital investor services with EBRD, ministry support

product_launches.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) launched a digital one-stop-shop services platform for investors, developed with the EBRD and Egypt's Ministry of International Cooperation. The platform aims to enhance business efficiency and transparency, featuring a CRM system, Smart Operations Management, and a Document Management System.

overview_description.description:
SCZONE is a world-class economic zone, Industrial and trade hub along the banks of the Suez Canal. Strategically located on the main trade route between Europe and South Asia.
Spanning 455 km2, SCZONE has four unique industrial zones and six strategically-located ports.

about_short_description.short_description: A world-class economic zone, Industrial and trade hub along the banks of the Suez Canal. A 455 km2 of 4 Industrial Zones & 6 ports.

product.name: Industrial Zones
product.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone comprises four industrial zones designed to support various sectors including textiles, automotive, and pharmaceuticals.

product.name: Ports
product.description: SCZONE includes six ports that facilitate international trade and logistics, enhancing connectivity between Asia, Africa, and Europe.

product.name: One-Stop-Shop Services
product.description: SCZONE offers streamlined services for business setup and operations, reducing the time required to incorporate a company to 48 hours.

product.name: Integrated Infrastructure
product.description: The zone provides comprehensive infrastructure including roads, railways, tunnels, and desalination plants to support industrial and commercial activities.

product.name: Investment Opportunities
product.description: SCZONE presents diverse investment opportunities across sectors such as logistics, petrochemicals, and renewable energy.

product.name: Bunkering Services
product.description: The zone offers bunkering services to support maritime activities, contributing to its role as a regional energy hub.
